subject: P2: carrier-sync FastShip label requests failing with 429
body: FastShip label API returning HTTP 429 for 35-52% of requests since 08:40. Label backlog growing, warehouse Dock 3 blocked. Hypotheses so far: retry storm (restart did not help), FastShip outage (status page green). Workers scaled 4 to 8. Status: investigating. On-call: karthik.rao.
